summary: Bryan Skilinski, 40, of New York — hiker who entered the Great Sand Dunes area May 8, 2017 and never returned; multi-agency search began May 14; body discovered June 25 and recovered June 26 between Milwaukee Peak and Marble Mountain
location: Great Sand Dunes National Preserve, between Milwaukee Peak and Marble Mountain
responding_agency: Custer County SAR + Saguache County SAR + Western Mountain Rescue + NPS + Flight for Life
notes: Cause of death unknown. Searched a 14-sq-mi area near Mt. Herard with dog teams from Larimer, Park, and El Paso counties, USFS Monument Helitack, Flight for Life, and DFPC multi-mission aircraft. CPD dates discovery June 25 / recovery June 26, 2017; GearJunkie (published June 30, 2017) says body found June 28 — dates differ.
